mapper.select: SELECT ar.task_id, t.title AS task_title, COALESCE(SUM(ar.duration_minutes), 0) AS total_minutes, t.status FROM activity_records ar JOIN tasks t ON ar.task_id = t.id WHERE DATE (ar.start_time) = #{date} GROUP BY ar.task_id, t.title, t.status ORDER BY total_minutes DESC

SELECT ar.task_id, t.title AS task_title, COALESCE(SUM(ar.duration_minutes), 0) AS total_minutes, t.status FROM activity_records ar JOIN tasks t ON ar.task_id = t.id WHERE DATE (ar.start_time) >= #{weekStart} AND DATE (ar.start_time) <= DATE_ADD(#{weekStart} , INTERVAL 6 DAY) GROUP BY ar.task_id, t.title, t.status ORDER BY total_minutes DESC
